Group Start.note: Gates MIDI on a Control value to stop samples triggering at silent chain volumes.

MPE Note Off.note: Stores each note's pressure, slide and pitch bend, replaying them on release.

Mod Table.note: Translates a macro's value through non-linear curves to set sample layers' chain volume.

Arduino.note: Connects switches, potentiometers and sensors to control Live parameters via Arduino Uno.

Camera.note: Fetches webcam data to control mappable Live parameters.

JSON Video.note: Fetches tagged looped video data from a web service using JSON.

JSON Weather.note: Fetches live weather data from a web API in JSON format.

LEGO MINDSTORMS EV3.note: Connects an EV3 Programmable Brick to Live, accessing its sensors and motors.

OSC Leap Motion.note: Uses a Leap Motion controller via an OSC bridge app to generate MIDI notes.

OSC MIDI Send.note: Sends MIDI note and velocity data out as OSC messages.

OSC Monitor.note: A simple monitor for viewing incoming OSC messages.

OSC Send.note: Converts any mappable Live parameter into outgoing OSC data.

OSC TouchOSC.note: Maps controllers from a TouchOSC layout to elements in Live.

littleBits.note: Uses the littleBits Arduino module with sensor Bits to control Live, and vice versa.

Convolution Reverb.note: Sample-based reverb using real-world impulse responses, with zero-latency processing.

Convolution Reverb Pro.note: Adds EQ, damping, modulation and IR-reversing controls beyond standard Convolution Reverb.

IR Measurement Device.note: Utility for recording custom impulse responses to use in Convolution Reverb.

Bass.note: Monophonic virtual analog synth covering clean to heavily distorted bass tones.

Color Limiter.note: Gritty hardware-style limiter with Loudness, Ceiling, Lookahead, Saturation and Color controls.

Gated Delay.note: A gate sequencer routes the signal into a delay line on rhythmic steps.

Melodic Steps.note: Fast MIDI sequencer creating evolving, polyrhythmic or randomised melodies.

Pitch Hack.note: Single delay line with semitone and cent transposition, reverse and randomised pitch.

Poli.note: Polyphonic virtual analog synth with detunable oscillators and built-in chorus.

Re-Enveloper.note: Multiband processor that compresses or expands the signal's envelope per frequency band.

Spectral Blur.note: Blurs a chosen frequency range into a dense, reverb-like cloud, with Freeze.

CV Clock In.note: Controls Live's tempo from an external Eurorack modular clock signal.

CV Clock Out.note: Sends a CV clock signal out to sync modular gear to Live's tempo.

CV Envelope Follower.note: Converts audio inside Live into CV for controlling modular gear.

CV In.note: Uses incoming CV from a modular rig to modulate parameters in Live.

CV Instrument.note: Plays modular oscillators from MIDI with flexible voicing and cent-accurate tuning.

CV LFO.note: Adds an extra LFO modulation source for a connected modular system.

CV Shaper.note: Draw custom CV envelope shapes in Live to send out to modular gear.

CV Triggers.note: Sequences modular drum modules with trigger signals from inside Live.

CV Utility.note: Adds, multiplies and offsets control voltages, processing CV like audio.

Rotating Rhythm Generator.note: MIDI effect generating organic, modular-style polyrhythms and beat patterns.

Harmonic Drone Generator.note: Eight-voice drone synth tunable to equal temperament or just intonation.

Mod Table.note: Shapes crossfades between the choir's mouth shapes and dynamic layers via curves.

Expressive Chords.note: Turns single notes into chords from curated sets, with MPE and Push support.

Patterns by Iftah.note: Algorithmic drum pattern generator with a separate generation algorithm per voice.

Sting by Iftah.note: Improvisational 16-step acid line generator with Type, Root, Transpose, Rate and Density.

Granulator III.note: Granular synth with Classic, Loop and Cloud modes plus MPE modulation.

Bouncy Notes.note: Gravity-based sequencer where a dropped ball bounces on a piano roll triggering notes.

Emit.note: Visual granular synth using phase vocoder playback, with particles crossing a spectrogram.

Tree Tone.note: Grows fractal tree-shaped resonator banks excited by internal noise or external audio.

Vector Delay.note: Multitap delay whose particles are separate delay lines with pitch-shift and reverse.

Vector FM.note: FM synth where each particle represents an operator oscillator pair.

Vector Grain.note: Granular looper where particles are grains mapped to pitch, position, filter and reverse.

Vector Map.note: Maps particle motion such as size, direction and velocity to eight parameters.

4Xfade.note: The Pack's single bundled Max device; Ableton's pack page does not describe it.

Granulator II.note: Quasi-synchronous granular synth with two multimode filters in series.

GranulatorFollow II.note: Companion device linking to Granulator II to expand voices across instances.

GranulatorInput II.note: Captures live audio from a track as Granulator II's source sample.

Arp.note: Pattern-based MIDI arpeggiator that sorts, repeats and transposes incoming notes.

Bass.note: Monophonic virtual analog synth covering clean to heavily distorted bass tones.

Buffer Shuffler 2.0.note: Sequences buffer glitch effects such as stutter, gate, pitch and frequency shift.

Convolution Reverb.note: Sample-based reverb using real-world impulse responses, with zero-latency processing.

Convolution Reverb Pro.note: Adds EQ, damping, modulation and IR-reversing controls beyond standard Convolution Reverb.

Device Randomizer.note: Randomly generates new parameter values for the device it is applied to.

DrumSynth Clap.note: Synthesises handclap sounds with velocity control over nearly every parameter.

DrumSynth Clave.note: Synthesises clave and woodblock percussion with velocity-controllable parameters.

DrumSynth Cymbal.note: Synthesises cymbal-style percussion with velocity-controllable parameters.

DrumSynth FM2.note: FM-based drum synthesiser for percussive and bass-like tones.

DrumSynth FMPerc.note: FM-based percussion synthesiser with velocity control over its parameters.

DrumSynth Glass.note: Synthesises glassy, bell-like percussion tones with velocity-controllable parameters.

DrumSynth HH.note: Synthesises hi-hat sounds with velocity control over nearly every parameter.

DrumSynth Kick.note: Synthesises kick drum sounds with velocity control over nearly every parameter.

DrumSynth Kplus.note: Extended kick drum synthesiser with additional tone-shaping parameters.

DrumSynth Shaker.note: Synthesises shaker percussion with velocity control over nearly every parameter.

DrumSynth Snare.note: Synthesises snare drum sounds with velocity control over nearly every parameter.

DrumSynth Snare2.note: Alternate snare drum synthesiser with velocity-controllable parameters.

DrumSynth Tom.note: Synthesises tom drum sounds with velocity control over nearly every parameter.

Envelope.note: Uses an envelope function generator to modulate a mapped Live parameter.

Envelope Follower.note: Tracks incoming audio amplitude and uses it to modulate mapped parameters.

Expression Control.note: Controls mapped parameters from MIDI and MPE expression sources.

IR Measurement Device.note: Utility for recording custom impulse responses to use in Convolution Reverb.

Instant Haus.note: Beat generator with patterns aimed at house music and broken beats.

LFO.note: Uses a low frequency oscillator to modulate mapped Live parameters.

LFO MIDI.note: MIDI-domain version of the LFO device for modulating parameters.

MIDIMonitor.note: Displays incoming MIDI data for monitoring and troubleshooting.

Map8.note: Maps up to eight parameters, suited to Push and eight-knob controllers.

Mono Sequencer.note: Sequences a monophonic line with lanes for note, velocity, octave and duration.

Multi.note: Multimode synthesiser combining several different synth engines in one device.

MultiMap.note: Maps up to eight parameters anywhere in the Live Set.

Note Echo.note: Creates echoed MIDI notes at set intervals with decreasing velocity.

PitchDrop.note: Recreates a vinyl record's motor slowing down, pitching the sound downward.

Poli.note: Polyphonic virtual analog synth with detunable oscillators and built-in chorus.

XY Pad.note: Controls two mapped Live parameters from an X/Y pad.

Microtuner.note: Imports, edits and generates microtonal scales, with MPE and lead/follow sync.

Phase Pattern.note: Manipulates timing, pitch and velocity across a clip for organic phasing results.

Polyrhythm.note: Produces polymetric and polyrhythmic patterns via six generators, including Euclidean modes.

Retrigger.note: Creates repeats of some or all MIDI notes in a clip, with velocity shaping.

Slice Shuffler.note: Applies variations such as reversal or randomness to separate slices of a clip.

Stages.note: Turns simple MIDI notes into longer patterns using sliders for pitch, repeats and rests.

Arrangement Looper.note: Loops your current position in Arrangement View using four customisable loop lengths.

Performer.note: Modular macro control device with faders, crossfaders, buttons and dials.

Prearranger.note: Pre-arranges clip placement so Live fills the slots with recorded content.

Variations.note: Captures and recalls snapshots of an entire Live Set, with parts included or excluded.

PitchLoop89.note: Two pitch-shifting delays inspired by the Publison DHM 89, with Push integration.

Dr Chaos.note: A neural network strings notes together to generate melodies unpredictably.

Melodic Probability.note: Monophonic step sequencer setting probability of event, pitch and octave per step.

Probability Arp.note: Arpeggiator with chord generator and probability for rate, direction, length and octave.

Rhythmic Probability.note: Polyphonic sequencer setting probability of velocity, length and event per step.

Step Divider.note: Polyphonic sequencer dividing each step into subdivisions for glitchy results.

Rhythmic Steps.note: Step sequencer for Drum Racks with trigger probability, alternate lanes and swing.

SQ Sequencer.note: 16-step hardware-style sequencer where each lane has its own length and direction.

Step Arp.note: Step arpeggiator controlling velocity, note length, chance and transposition per step.

Color.note: Texture device adding vinyl noise, hiss, drive, wobble and analog warmth.

ConChord.note: Pulse-based chord step sequencer where each step varies pulse count and generates chords.

MSE.note: Small synth module played mono or poly, from fat bass sounds to lush pads.

Quad.note: Four MSE synths stacked, each note playing one module in turn like an Oberheim.

Seq8.note: Analog-style eight-step sequencer with swing, MIDI scaling and a map function.

SkramDelay.note: Dual-channel delay with modulated, randomised delay times for glitch effects.

Stochastic Delay.note: Two stochastically driven delay engines with post filters and built-in reverb.

Verbotron.note: Stereo reverb effect built on the original Gigaverb algorithm.

Group Start.note: Gates MIDI on a Control value to stop samples triggering at silent chain volumes.

MPE Note Off.note: Stores each note's pressure, slide and pitch bend, replaying them on release.

Mod Table.note: Translates a macro's value through non-linear curves to set sample layers' chain volume.

Surround Panner.note: XY multi-speaker panner with Rotate, Smooth, Focus and Center controls.

Max AutoPanner.note: Auto-panning utility that moves the signal across the stereo field.

Max CombFilter.note: A stereo comb filter with pitch control.

Max DelayTaps.note: Delay effect offering up to 32 delay taps.

PluggoFuzz.note: Distorts the input using four clipping modes and multi-mode filters.

Speed Shifter.note: Simulates two tape loops running at different speeds feeding back into each other.

Tapped Delay.note: Delay line with 16 equally spaced taps, each adjustable in level and pan.

Custom Note Off.note: Triggers hammer-noise samples on key release, even while the sustain pedal is held.

Pedal Noise.note: Triggers recorded pedal-press and pedal-release noise samples from sustain pedal data.

Piano Pedal Trigger.note: Gates MIDI to switch between pedal-up and pedal-down sustained sample layers.
